title: Cyber Shield Agents
seoLead: Alert! A hacker called Phantom is trying to break into the school network. The Cyber Shield agency is recruiting new agents.

startLead.one: Alert! A hacker called **Phantom** is trying to break into the school network. The **CyberShield** agency is recruiting new agents. Complete {count} training mission, collect the keys and open the headquarters door.
startLead.other: Alert! A hacker called **Phantom** is trying to break into the school network. The **CyberShield** agency is recruiting new agents. Complete {count} training missions, collect the keys and open the headquarters door.

howMissionsText: Detective pictures, a chat, fake websites, a fake-news detector, memory games and word searches.
howKeysText: Each mission you complete gives you a key letter.
howWordText: Put the keys in order to make the secret word and get your agent ID card.
startNote: The stopwatch starts when you click.
resumeHint: If this isn’t your quest, click “Start again”.
mapLead: Missions open one by one. Complete them all to collect the secret word.
greenMarked: The correct options are marked in green.
classifySeeRed: Read the explanations next to the lines marked in red.
hsMissed: The clues you missed are circled with a red dashed line.
hsAll: Here are all the signs of {what}:
sceneHint: Hint: clicking a safe object costs you a point, but clicking an empty spot doesn’t.
sceneDoneText: The explanation for each find is in the list above this message.
sceneGaveText: The ones you missed are marked in red on the picture.
privFix: Next to each red setting you can read what is wrong with it.
chatFirstTry: First choices right on the first try: {pts} of {total}.
memDoneText: You needed {moves} moves. Points: up to {a} moves — 3, up to {b} — 2, up to {c} — 1.
wsHint: Click the first letter of a word, then click the last one.
wsNone: There is no word from the list here. Try again!
wsDoneText: You really know your cyber words!
wsGaveText: The words you didn’t find are circled with a red dashed line.
pwWarn: Careful, agent! Never type your real password here. Use an invented one.
pwCrit6: No simple words or sequences (qwerty, 12345, password)
pwHint: Hint: take three words that are easy to picture together and add numbers and symbols. For example: Cat#Cloud7Pie
pwDoneText: Phantom can’t guess a password like this. But remember: keep your real passwords secret and never write them on paper next to the computer.
finalLead: Click the keys in the right order. The word will open the CyberShield headquarters door.
finalWrong: That’s not the word. Try again!
finalHint: Hint: what does a CyberShield agent do? They defend. The word starts with “D”.
ngNote: Your name isn’t saved on this device, so please type it again.

certText.one: Completed {count} mission, collected the keys and solved the secret word **{word}**. Now Phantom won’t get through!
certText.other: Completed {count} missions, collected the keys and solved the secret word **{word}**. Now Phantom won’t get through!

handoffText: Show this screen to your teacher, or copy the line below and send it the way your teacher asked (for example, in the class chat or Google Classroom).
copySelect: The text is selected. Press Ctrl+C (or Cmd+C).
againArmed: Are you sure? Your result will be erased. Click again
resultLine: {who} — Cyber Shield Agents: {pts} of {total} points, rank “{rank}”, time {time}, {date}
